IN THE HIGH COURT OF MALAYA AT KUALA LUMPUR
CIVIL SUIT NO: 22-12345-2024

BETWEEN

PLAINTIFF SDN BHD  ... PLAINTIFF

AND

DEFENDANT SDN BHD  ... DEFENDANT

CORAM: TAN SRI JUSTICE AHMAD

GROUNDS OF JUDGMENT

[1] This is the judgment of the court.

[2] The plaintiff brought this action for breach of contract arising from a construction agreement dated 1 January 2020.

[3] The defendant denies liability and raises a counterclaim.

[4] Having heard submissions from both parties, I find in favour of the plaintiff.

[5] IT IS HEREBY ORDERED that the defendant pay the plaintiff the sum of RM 500,000.00 together with costs of RM 50,000.00.

Signed: TAN SRI JUSTICE AHMAD
